mapper.select: SELECT tl.gid, count(tlal.USER) AS pv, count(DISTINCT tlal.USER) AS uv, count(DISTINCT tlal.ip) AS uip FROM t_link tl INNER JOIN t_link_access_logs tlal ON tl.full_short_url = tlal.full_short_url WHERE tl.gid = #{bean.gid} AND tl.del_flag = '0' AND tl.enable_status = '0' GROUP BY tl.gid;

SELECT tlal.ip, count(*) AS cnt FROM t_link tl INNER JOIN t_link_access_logs tlal ON tl.full_short_url = tlal.full_short_url WHERE tl.gid = #{bean.gid} AND tlal.`date` BETWEEN #{bean.startDate} AND #{bean.endDate} AND tl.del_flag = '0' AND tl.enable_status = '0' GROUP BY tl.gid, tlal.ip LIMIT 5;

SELECT tlal.* FROM t_link tl INNER JOIN t_link_access_logs tlal ON tl.full_short_url = tlal.full_short_url WHERE tl.gid = #{bean.gid} AND tl.del_flag = '0' AND tl.enable_status = '0' AND tlal.create_time BETWEEN #{bean.startDate} AND #{bean.endDate} ORDER BY tlal.create_time DESC
